articles.title: Spanish economist de Cos to succeed Lagarde as head of ECB
articles.description: Spanish monetary economist Pablo Hernandez de Cos on Thursday was set to replace France's Christine Lagarde as the new head of the European Central Bank (ECB). articles.title: Lost homes, stolen freedom: National Book Award winners on exile and imprisonment
articles.description: Two books about losing everything have just won America's most prestigious literary honours. Hannah Lillith Assadi took the National Book Award for fiction for "Paradiso 17", a novel inspired by her late father, who was driven from Palestine in 1948 during the Nakba. Abdelrahman ElGendy won the non-fiction prize for "Huna", his memoir of six years as a political prisoner in Egypt, arrested at 17 alongside his father. ElGendy couldn't be in New York to collect his award: his visa was denied.

articles.title: Live: EU leaders meet in Brussels amid division over Ukraine funding
